newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks end sharply up but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks end sharply up but trade thin.

text.p: Solid gains in the futures market and a rally in conglomerates swept Hong Kong stocks to a higher close on Friday, but trading volume was lacklustre as the market's recent slide kept investors on edge, brokers said.
The Hang Seng Index closed on a gain of 149.42 points, or 1.24 percent, at 12,204.59. Turnover was HK$4.91 billion compared with HK$6.98 billion on Thursday.

"It's just a technical rebound. The market is a bit oversold," said Patrick Chia, research director at China Everbright Research. "The turnover is very low and a lot of people are still staying on the sidelines," he said.
Brokers said investors were awaiting U.S. March employment data due later on Friday and feared that the U.S. Federal Reserve would raise interest rates again in May.
"This volume indicates that people have decided to lay off and stay on the sidelines for the time being," said Kent Rossiter, institutional sales manager at Nikko Securities.
Turnover was the lowest for a full-day session since September 26 last year.

Friday's gains narrowed the losses made during this four-day week to 329.73 points, or 2.63 percent. The market was closed on Monday for the Easter holiday. Ben Kwong, director of research at Dharmala Securities, said investors had been unwilling to participate in the market following recent selling.
"As the market has dropped a lot recently it takes time to recover the confidence," he said.
"In the short term it is still very much affected by futures-linked trading. Blue chips lack direction so traders are using futures," Kwong added.
The April Hang Seng Index futures contract jumped 170 points to 12,180, aided by short covering, brokers said.
They said the tone next week would be dictated by the U.S. economic data to be released later.
Shares in Hutchison Whampoa Ltd jumped HK$1.25 to HK$55.25 and Wharf (Holdings) Ltd gained HK$1.00 to HK$29.75. Swire Pacific Ltd ended at HK$60.75, up HK$0.75.

Major property counters also made strong gains. Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd rose HK$1.00 to HK$64.50 and Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd advanced HK$1.00 to HK$78.00. Henderson Land Development Co Ltd gained HK$0.75 to HK$61.75.
